# \# Spec 012 — Final Validation

# 

# \## Objective

# 

# Validate the complete stylized foliage shader in Unity.

# 

# A feature is not complete solely because it compiles.

# 

# \## Console

# 

# There must be:

# 

# 0 shader compilation errors

# 0 material property errors

# 0 MissingReference errors generated by the shader test setup

# 

# \## Test Objects

# 

# Validate on:

# 

# Tree\_Test

# Foliage\_Test

# Sphere\_Test when relevant

# 

# Also validate on at least one additional imported tree if available.

# 

# \## Lighting Test

# 

# Rotate Sun around the tree.

# 

# Check:

# 

# front lighting

# side lighting

# back lighting

# high sun

# lower sun

# 

# The tree must maintain coherent stylized volume.

# 

# \## Required Visual Characteristics

# 

# Confirm:

# 

# \- alpha silhouette is clean

# \- foliage cards are double sided

# \- shadows use alpha clipping

# \- canopy reads as rounded volumes

# \- lighting does not expose individual card orientation strongly

# \- shadow transitions are soft

# \- shadow colors remain saturated

# \- canopy interior is darker

# \- exposed outer foliage is brighter

# \- detail variation remains subtle

# \- normal map does not destroy spherical shading

# \- tree remains visually stable at distance

# 

# \## Material Controls

# 

# Verify each exposed artistic property produces an understandable visible change.

# 

# Remove unused properties.

# 

# Do not expose internal technical constants unnecessarily.

# 

# \## Performance

# 

# Avoid unnecessary texture samples and expensive calculations.

# 

# Prefer simple procedural masks when equivalent results are possible.

# 

# No per-pixel loops.

# 

# No dynamic branching unless justified.

# 

# \## Source Asset Safety

# 

# Do not destructively modify original imported tree assets.

# 

# Test changes should use materials, shader assets, prefab instances or copies.

# 

# \## Final Deliverable

# 

# Report:

# 

# 1\. Shader asset path

# 2\. Test material path

# 3\. Test scene path

# 4\. Implemented features

# 5\. Material properties

# 6\. Known limitations

# 7\. Recommended default values

# 8\. Any model-authoring assumptions
